# Model-surface audit — Softimage dumps vs AfterImage `src/`

**Date:** 2026-10-27  
**Source:** committed dump artifacts only (softimage-pc not connected)  
**Scope:** Model tab  
**Generated by:** `tools/build_model_surface_audit.py`  
**Runtime audit:** `src/ui/modelSurfaceAudit.ts` → `__uiAudit().modelSurface`

## Verdicts

| Verdict | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| PRESENT | AfterImage already carried the item with dump-attested names / metrics. |
| PARTIAL | Surface existed, behaviour or fields incomplete against the dump. |
| MISSING | Dump exposes it, AfterImage had nothing. |
| ABSENT | Deliberately not wired — no attestable Softimage name, or no AfterImage counterpart. |

Verdicts describe `src/` **before** this pass. The **Wired** column marks the items the pass closed.

## Clean-room

Dumps are specification only: menu labels, command names, script names, SPDL parameter contracts, dialog titles and control text.
Decompiled or disassembled code is not pasted into `src/` or `native/`.
`siuitasks.dll` dialog 202 is titled User Keyword(s) and is outside the Model tab, so it is not in this table.
Feature Match on Curve Net has no solver in the committed dumps; the parameter is stored and the existing curve-net surface is unchanged.
Deform by Spine keeps the radius and falloff values already shipped; the spine dump did not list them, and this pass does not remove them.
